name: Harbin Boshi Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: Harbin Boshi Automation Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of intelligent manufacturing equipment and industrial robots in the People's Republic of China. It offers industrial robots, smelting robot equipment, weighing equipment, palletizing systems, conveying inspection equipment, intelligent logistics systems, rubber post-processing equipment, and energy-saving and environment protection equipment, as well as provides technical support and training, spare parts, maintenance and overhaul, operation-guaranteed, production and operation, and services network services.
